disciplines.blurb: Put your phone in front of you and shadow box. Your corner calls out guard, stance and balance — no bag, no sensors.

measured: Punch events and count — a fact from the phase machine, not a grade
Combination order and timing, for the punches we model. A combination built from hooks or uppercuts is not ordered, because those punches are not recognised in the first place
Stance width, crossed feet, balance — these are graded

Guard hand position — detected and coached, but NOT graded. Coaches disagree about it: across our reference takes the rear forearm spread past 45 degrees, and we do not know how far past. We will flag a dropping hand; we will not put a number on it

Tempo as a band (controlled / brisk / fast), derived from how long the punch takes to extend — not from pixel speed. The engine uses it to decide when to say slow down, and the session summary shows the band you spent the most time in
notMeasured: Punch force or power — a camera cannot measure force, and we will not pretend otherwise

Punch mechanics — the path your arm takes is coached, not graded. We do have reference takes for the jab, so this is not a gap in our data: the arm is simply where coaches disagree most, and the lead arm most of all.

Hook and uppercut technique — not modelled. We ran a real hook lesson through the app: it missed almost every hook, and the handful it did register it counted as jabs or crosses. We would rather say that than let a wrong number look right.
Head movement quality (slip / duck / roll) — reaction skills need an opponent
Anything while your body is out of frame or tracking confidence is low — the app says so instead of guessing

courses.goal: Build a stance and a jab you can repeat without thinking.

lessons.teach:
Stand where you can take two steps in any direction without hitting anything. Prop the phone at about waist height, leaning on something solid — a chair, a shelf, a wall.

Then step back until your feet and your hands both fit in the picture at the same time. That is the whole test. If your feet leave the frame when you punch, you are too close.

Turn slightly toward the camera rather than standing square to it. A boxing guard is side-on, and from directly in front your rear hand hides behind your body — the camera reads a hand it cannot see as a hand that is not there.

The room only needs enough light that you can see your own hands clearly. We do not measure the light, so we cannot tell you when it is too dark; you can.
lessons.$cameraBasis: ADR-005: bu dersin ilerleme kapisi (curriculum.json 'setupCheckPassed') tespit-turevi — kurulum dersinin KENDISI kamerayi acmiyor olmasi J-197'nin en carpici kaniti idi. usesCamera:true onu duzeltir. ⚠️ NAMED ACIK KALEM: 'setupCheckPassed' adli bir olay motor kodunda bugun HICBIR YERDE uretilmiyor (repo geneli arama, sifir eslesme) — kamera-gerekliligi dogru ama bu spesifik kapi-olayinin ureticisi yazilmadi, bu turun kapsami disinda (yeni motor yuzeyi acmak).

lessons.teach:
Feet about shoulder width, lead foot forward, rear heel slightly lifted. Weight sits between your feet — not forward on the toes, not back on the heels.

Hands up: lead hand out around chin height, rear hand touching your cheek. The rear hand is the one that keeps you safe and the one that gets tired first. When it drops, you will hear about it.

Stay tall. The most common fault in the first week is folding forward at the waist to reach further — it feels stronger and it takes your balance with it.

We can see stance width, crossed feet and balance, and we grade those. We can see your guard hand and we will tell you when it drops, but we do not put a number on it: experienced coaches disagree about where exactly it belongs.
lessons.$cameraBasis: ADR-005: bu dersin ilerleme kapisi (curriculum.json 'stanceHold') tespit-turevi. Odak hatalarinin ucu de (STANCE_TOO_NARROW/WIDE, FEET_CROSSED) A bandinda ve gateable:true (drill.stance_reset/drill.balance/drill.footwork_basics, M-F-06 geometrik durus dedektoru GERCEK) — kamera-gerekliligi saglam. ⚠️ NAMED ACIK KALEM: 'stanceHold' adli spesifik kapi-olayi motor kodunda bugun uretilmiyor (sifir eslesme) — tespit yetenegi gercek, bu tek gate-primitifinin ureticisi yazilmadi, bu turun kapsami disinda.

lessons.teach:
The jab is your lead hand, travelling straight out and straight back on the same line. It is not a big punch. It is the one that measures distance and buys you time.

Push from the floor, turn the shoulder, let the arm follow. Fist finishes where your eyes are pointing. Elbow stays down and behind the fist — when the elbow swings out to the side, the punch stops being a jab.

The return matters as much as the punch. A hand that comes back slowly is a hand that is not home when it is needed. We do not call this one out today — watch for it yourself.

Throw them at a pace you can hold. Speed that costs you shape is not speed — it is a faster way to practise something you do not want.
lessons.$cameraBasis: Bu ders KAMERA hattini acar (J-096): teknik listesi tam olarak ['jab'] ve jab modellenmis TEK teknik. Kanca/uppercut modellenmedigi icin kombinasyon dersleri kamerayi ACMAZ - acsalardi kullanici izin verir, pil yanar ve sayim yanlis cikardi.

lessons.teach:
Both hands stay in front of your face and the punches leave from there. Lead hand out around chin height, rear hand touching your cheek. Elbows down and in — a guard held with the elbows out looks tighter than it is, because the hands are up and the middle is open.

This lesson is jabs, but the jab is not the point. The point is what the other hand does while the jab is away, and what the jab hand does on the way back.

The rear hand is the first thing fatigue takes. It drifts down a few centimetres at a time and it does not feel like anything happening. Throw slowly enough that you can feel it stay.

We can see both hands during the punch, and we call it out when the rear hand drops. A slow return on the lead hand is a real fault too, but we do not call that one out today. Neither carries a number: experienced coaches disagree about exactly where the guard belongs, so what fires is a flag, not a score.
lessons.$leadHandRecoveryCorrection: OLCULDU 2026-08-12 (koordinatorun 4. katman ongorusu, kendi olcumumle sinandi): LEAD_HAND_NOT_RECOVERED evaluateAt:['RETRACTION'] ile GERCEKTEN dispatch ediliyor (RETRACTION gercek bir faz) ama kosulu (`phaseDurationMs.RETRACTION`) HICBIR ZAMAN degerlendirilemiyor — `_phaseDurations` haritasini dolduran `setPhaseDuration`/`clearPhaseDurations` motorda SIFIR yerden cagriliyor, yani `phaseDurationMs()` her zaman null donuyor ve `Clause.test` null'da `false` donuyor. Bu, error_reachability_test'in (evaluateAt/marker katmani) YAKALAYAMADIGI YENI bir sinif: dispatch CALISIYOR, veri KAYNAGI hic beslenmemis. Eski jab/guard metinleri bu hatanin CANLI oldugunu iddia ediyordu ('we call it out by name' / 'comes home late') — duzeltildi. lessons.$cameraBasis: Teknik listesi tam olarak ['jab'] — jab modellenmis TEK teknik, o yuzden kamera hatti acilabilir (emsal: boxing.foundations.jab). VE ONEMLI: bu dersin iki odak hatasi da YUMRUK FAZI istiyor (REAR_HAND_LOW: EXTENSION+PEAK, LEAD_HAND_NOT_RECOVERED: RETRACTION). Yumruk atilmayan bir 'gard dersi' yazilsaydi bu hatalar HIC FIRLAYAMAZDI ve ogretim metnindeki 'dustugunde soyleriz' cumlesi KARSILIKSIZ bir vaat olurdu. Ders bu yuzden jab atarak kuruldu.

lessons.teach:
Two things go wrong when a punch has to travel further than it should. The elbow swings out to find a shortcut, and the body leans in to cover the distance.

The elbow first. A straight punch keeps the elbow under and behind the fist for as long as it can. When the elbow lifts out to the side, the fist arrives on a curve — wider, slower, and no longer the punch you were practising.

Then the lean. If you have to fall forward to land, you were not in range. Reaching puts your weight over your lead foot and takes away the thing that lets you throw the next one.

The fix is under you, not in front of you. Step in, then punch. Range is a footwork problem wearing an arm problem's clothes.

We can see the elbow angle and the forward lean, and we call both out. Neither carries a number: the thresholds behind them are not calibrated, so you get the flag and not a score.
lessons.$cameraBasis: Teknik listesi tam olarak ['jab'] (emsal: boxing.foundations.jab). Odak hatalarinin ikisi de yumruk fazi istiyor (ELBOW_FLARED: EXTENSION+PEAK, OVERREACH: PEAK) — yumruksuz bir 'mesafe dersi' bu hatalari uretemezdi.
lessons.$gapBasis: BU DERS OLCULMUS BIR BOSLUGU KAPATIYOR: ELBOW_FLARED ve OVERREACH, motorun gordugu ve kocun seslendirdigi 14 hatadan HICBIR DERSIN ele almadigi ikisiydi (J-188 olcumu). Ikisi de band 'B-kal' ve severity 'medium'; ogretim metni bu yuzden SAYI VAAT ETMIYOR.

lessons.teach:
The cross is the rear hand, and it travels a longer road: it starts further away and it has to cross your body to arrive. That distance is where its weight comes from and also where the trouble comes from.

Turn the rear foot and hip first, then the shoulder, then let the hand go. If the arm leads, you are throwing with your arm alone and reaching for the target with your chest.

Your lead hand does not go on holiday while the cross is out. It stays up. The most common shape fault here is one hand out and the other drifting down at the same time.

We cannot tell you how hard it lands. A camera sees shape and timing, not force, and we will not print a number we did not take.

One is the jab, two is the cross. Thrown together, the jab is not just a punch — it is what makes room for the one behind it.

Let the jab come back before the cross goes out. The two punches share one line and one balance; if the second starts while the first is still travelling, you end up leaning into the shot with both hands away from your face.

Land back in your stance, not past it. Finishing a combination out of position is how a good pair of punches becomes a bad third one.

We watch the jab and the cross on their own, the same way we watch them everywhere else. Judging the two together as a combination — a wrong hand, a wrong order — is not something the app does today.
lessons.$teachCorrection: J-162/163 KESIN cozuldu (2026-08-12, magaza metni capraz kontrolunden): eski metin 'We watch the order and the timing between the two' diyordu. Olcum: WRONG_HAND_FOR_COMBINATION/COMBINATION_ORDER_ERROR evaluateAt:['COMBINATION_END'] istiyor, COMBINATION_END motorda SIFIR yerde dispatch ediliyor (bkz. boxing@1.0.0.json $unreachableErrorCodesWhy) — bu iki hata KALICI ERISILEMEZ. Sira-takibi A bandinda (kapinin kendi $gateableWhy'i: 'olay sirasi blur'dan bagimsiz'). ⚠️ NAMED ACIK KALEM: J-162/163'te COMBINATION_END'in motorda hic gecmedigi olculmustu ve bu ADR o olcumu YENIDEN sinamadi (baslangic promptunun ayri, kapanista bilerek birakilan 2. isi) — usesCamera:true kavramsal olarak dogru, kapinin somut olayinin bugun ateslendigi dogrulanmadi.

lessons.teach:
Three minutes, one round, nothing to reach. The only goal is to keep the shape you have been practising while the clock runs and your arms start to complain.

Work at a pace you could hold for a second round even though there is not one. If you are throwing so fast that your hands stop coming home, you are practising the fault, not the punch.

Somewhere around the two minute mark the rear hand starts to sit lower. That is not a character flaw, it is fatigue, and it is exactly what a round is for: it shows you where your shape ends.

The clock runs whether or not the camera can read you. If it loses you, it will say so rather than go quiet.

Techniques zaten ['jab','cross'] ve emsal jab/guard/range ile ayni desen.

courses.goal: Work rounds without a bag. The app keeps time, counts what it can see, and stays quiet about what it can't.

lessons.teach:
Three rounds of three minutes, ninety seconds between them. That shape is not a style choice — the total time this lesson claims is twelve minutes, nine of them working, so the rest falls out of the arithmetic.

Round one is easy and that is the trap: the pace you set there is the pace you have to pay for in round three. Start slower than feels right.

Use the rest. Ninety seconds is long enough to get your breath fully back, and coming back to a round already tired teaches your body a shape you do not want.

The clock runs whether or not the camera can read you. If it loses you it says so, and the round keeps going.
lessons.$cameraBasis: ADR-005: ilerleme kapisi (sessionMinutes + withValidAnalysisRatio:0.7) tespit-turevi — gecerli-analiz orani judgedRatio'nun karsiligi. Techniques ['jab','cross'], emsal jab/guard/range/first_round.

roundPlan.$planBasis: Ad "3 x 3 minute rounds" tur sayisini VE tur suresini beyan ediyor; dinlenme beyan edilen toplamdan ARITMETIKLE cikiyor: 720-540=180 sn, 2 araya bolunmus = 90 sn. Icat YOK.

lessons.teach:
Ten minutes, one round, no break — and the missing break is the point.

Rest resets the drift that fatigue puts into your timing, and that drift is exactly the thing this lesson is about. Break it into pieces and you measure a fresh boxer three times instead of a tiring one once.

Hold one pace. Not your fastest and not a crawl: the speed you could still be throwing at minute nine. Most people find it about two thirds of what they started with.

We read tempo from how long the punch takes to extend, not from how fast anything moves across the screen. That is why a slow arm close to the camera and a quick one far away do not fool it.

We do not judge whether the pace is costing your form — that call is yours to make.

lessons.teach:
One round, five minutes. Longer than a boxing round on purpose — this is conditioning, not a fight.

Somewhere past minute three the shape starts to go before the effort does. Hands sit a little lower, the return gets a little lazy, the feet stop resetting. Nothing dramatic, and that is why it is worth watching for.

When you notice it, do not speed up to make up for it. Slow down until the shape comes back. A clean minute is worth more here than two ragged ones.

No rest, because there is no second round to rest for.

lessons.teach:
Ten minutes of work, split into three rounds with rest between them.

Two hundred seconds a round is arithmetic, not tradition: ten minutes of work, split three ways. It is worth knowing that the same sum, done independently for the twenty minute lesson, lands on the same round length.

The rest is a ratio borrowed from the three by three lesson, not something we measured. We are telling you that because a number you cannot check should at least come with a note saying where it came from.

Aim to finish round three looking like round one. That is the whole exercise.

Dinlenme 100 sn: r3 emsalindeki 1:2 is-dinlenme orani (180:90) ayni oranla 200:100 olarak uygulandi.

Ders adi "Ten minutes" CALISMA suresini adlandiriyor (kapinin $why metniyle tutarli). Insan-antrenor dogrulamasi bekliyor.

lessons.teach:
Six rounds, twenty minutes of work. The longest thing in this course.

Sixty seconds between rounds — the corner-break convention, chosen rather than measured. Short enough that fatigue carries across, which is the point of a long session.

By round four you will find out which part of your shape goes first. For most people it is the rear hand, then the return, then the feet. Learning your own order is more useful than any score we could print.

Long enough that the app's own tracking gets tested too — it will tell you if it loses you.

roundPlan.$planBasis: Tur sayisi (6) OGRETME METNINDE beyanli ("Six rounds, twenty minutes of work"); CALISMA suresi kapida beyanli (sessionMinutes=20 => 1200 sn). 1200/6 = 200 sn/tur — SAF ARITMETIK. BAGIMSIZ TUTARLILIK KONTROLU: r10 da ayni yolla 200 sn/tur veriyor, yani iki ders birbirinden bagimsiz olarak AYNI tur uzunlugunu dogruluyor. Dinlenme 60 sn: bokstaki neredeyse evrensel "kose molasi" konvansiyonu.
roundPlan.$planBoundary: Dinlenme 60 sn bir konvansiyon secimidir, beyan DEGIL; kapi gecilebilirligini etkilemez. Toplam: 6x200+5x60 = 1500 sn = 25 dk (ad "Twenty minutes" calisma suresini adlandiriyor). Insan-antrenor dogrulamasi bekliyor.

lessons.teach:
Twelve bursts of thirty seconds, thirty seconds of recovery between each. Six minutes of work inside twelve minutes of clock.

Go hard in the burst. Genuinely hard — this is the one lesson where pace beats polish.

At that intensity your shape will drift, and that is expected rather than a failure: we asked you for a tempo that costs shape. Take the corrections you see here as information about where your limit is, not as a verdict on the round.

The thirty-thirty cycle is a common starting split, not a measurement of ours. If it is too much, take the burst at three quarters rather than shortening it — keeping the clock honest matters more than the intensity.
lessons.$judgementWhy: Yuksek tempoda form hukmu VERILMEZ. TEMPO_TOO_FAST_FOR_FORM zaten C bandinda; hizli aralikta 'kotu form' demek, kullaniciya kendi tasarladigimiz egzersiz icin ceza kesmektir.

Otorite secimi gerekcesi: HIIT"in TUR KIMLIGI kisa-toplam yuksek-yogunluktur — kapi-otorite yolu 24 dakikalik bir "hiit" uretirdi ve blurb"un "short intervals with short rest" beyanini cignerdi. 30/30 baslangic-guvenli standart dongu ve cue kadansina oturuyor. Aritmetik TAM; icat YOK.
intervalPlan.$planBoundary: 30/30 secimi bir KONVANSIYON (baslangic-guvenli standart dongu), olculmus bir esik degil. Kapi gecilebilirligini etkilemez (kapi calisma suresini sayar) ama dersin zorlugunu belirler — insan-antrenor dogrulamasi bekliyor.

lessons.$teachBoundary: Bu metin ONCE 'form koclugu burada susar' diyordu — ve KODDA OYLE BIR SEY YOK (J-119). cues.en.json'un interval grup notu bunu VARSAYIYOR ('Bu grup calisirken FORM repliklerinin susturuldugunu varsayar') ama _coachSurface aralik kipinde de r.cue'yu aynen ciziyor. Metin KODA uyduruldu, kod metne DEGIL: olmayan bir davranisi ogretmek, gecenin bes kez yakaladigi kusur sinifinin ta kendisi olurdu. Celiski koordinatore tasindi.

lessons.teach:
Three rounds of three minutes, and the only kind of round where the form feedback stays on the whole time.

That makes it the slowest lesson here, and it should be. You are not trying to fit punches into the time; you are trying to make each one the same as the last.

There is a real tension in leaving feedback on continuously, and we would rather name it than hide it: being corrected on every repetition can make you lean on the correction instead of learning the movement. Today that tension is theoretical — the correction only appears when the camera can read you, and the shape of it will be worth revisiting once it does so on a real device.

Ninety seconds of rest, which is generous for the work. Here the rest is less about breath and more about resetting, so the next round starts from your shape rather than the last round's drift.
lessons.$cameraBasis: ADR-005: ilerleme kapisi (sessionMinutes + withValidAnalysisRatio:0.7) tespit-turevi — gecerli-analiz orani judgedRatio'nun karsiligi. Techniques ['jab','cross'], emsal jab/guard/range/first_round. Bu ders zaten form-geri-bildirimini SUREKLI acik tutuyor (teach metni) — kameranin ACIK olmasi dersin kendi anlattigi mekanizmayla tutarli.

roundPlan.$planBasis: TUR SURESI TEK COZUM: kapi 540sn CALISMA istiyor ve uygulamada kullanilan tur uzunluklari (180sn r3 · 200sn r10/r20 · 300sn r5) icinde 540"i TAM bolen YALNIZ 180sn var (3 tur). 200 → 2,70 tur, 300 → 1,80 tur. Yani tur sayisi da uzunlugu da aritmetikten cikiyor; blurb"un "rounds" (cogul) beyani da saglaniyor. Dinlenme 90sn: r3"un birebir ayni orani (180:90 = 1:2) — advisor da bu ders icin comert dinlenme onerdi, gerekcesi dinlenmenin burada fiziksel toparlanmadan cok SIFIRLAMA islevi gormesi.
roundPlan.$planBoundary: DINLENME (90sn) r3 emsalinden alinan bir ORAN secimidir, beyan degil; kapi gecilebilirligini etkilemez.
roundPlan.$guidanceHypothesisTension: GUIDANCE-HYPOTHESIS GERILIMI — ISIMLI COZULDU (M-F-149 talimati): advisor, bu dersin "surekli feedback acik kalan TEK tur tipi" onculunun motor-ogrenme literaturundeki guidance-hypothesis ile (surekli eszamanli geri bildirim BAGIMSIZ retansiyonu zayiflatabilir) gerilim halinde oldugunu isaretledi ve tur suresinin bu gerilimin cozumune bagli oldugunu soyledi. COZUM: gerilim tur SURESIYLE degil feedback FREKANSIYLA/solmasiyla yonetilir — kisa tur, surekli feedback"i seyrekleştirmez. Dahasi gerilim BUGUN YOK: kamera koprusu bagli olmadigi icin "surekli feedback" diye bir sey CALISMYOR (hukum yuvasi susuyor). Bu yuzden tur suresi aritmetigin tek cozumunu izliyor. GERILIM TASINIYOR: kamera canli hukum verdigi gun tur suresi VE feedback-solma birlikte yeniden ele alinmali — o gun bu alan yeniden okunacak.

lessons.teach:
Four rounds of five minutes. Long rounds, deliberately — the same twenty minutes split into six shorter rounds would just be the twenty minute lesson again.

Do not change pace to survive it. The point is to hold one pace long enough that your technique, not your will, becomes the limit.

Sixty seconds of rest, kept short on purpose. Fatigue has to carry from one round to the next or there is no trend to see.

What you are looking for is not whether you finish. It is which thing goes first, and how early. That answer is yours and it does not need a number attached to it.
lessons.$cameraBasis: ADR-005: ilerleme kapisi (sessionMinutes + withValidAnalysisRatio:0.7) tespit-turevi — gecerli-analiz orani judgedRatio'nun karsiligi. Techniques ['jab','cross'], emsal jab/guard/range/first_round. Kurstaki en uzun tur (20 dk toplam) — surekli cikarimin en zorlu vakasi (ADR-005 pil/isi bolumu).

roundPlan.$planBasis: Kapi 1200sn CALISMA istiyor. Uygulamada kullanilan uzunluklar icinde 1200"u TAM bolen IKI cozum var (200x6 ve 300x4) — AYRIMI BLURB YAPIYOR: "Long rounds". 200x6 yapisi r20 ile BIREBIR AYNI olurdu, yani "long rounds" beyani YANLIS olur ve ders r20"den ayirt edilemezdi. 300sn (5 dk) uygulamadaki en uzun tur (r5"in tek turu) ve r-serisinin 180/200"unden gercekten UZUN. Yani 4x300 = 1200sn tek tutarli cozum; icat yok.
roundPlan.$planBoundary: DINLENME (60sn) bokstaki "kose molasi" konvansiyonu (r20 emsali) ve ogretme metninin "Do not change pace to survive it" cercevesiyle tutarli: yorgunluk-trendi olculecekse dinlenme KISA olmali, yoksa her turda toparlanip trend silinir. Konvansiyon secimi, beyan degil; kapi gecilebilirligini etkilemez.

courses.$goalWhy: J-132: hedef ONCE "Combinations, tempo control and recovery under fatigue" diyordu ve UC KUSUR tasiyordu. ① Kursun 4 dersinin 3'U KILITLI — hedef acilamayan bir kursu acilabilir gibi tarif ediyordu. ② Ilk andigi konu ("Combinations") tam da KILITLI dersin kendisi. ③ "tempo control" bu kursta HIC YOK — o ders conditioning'de. Sinif J-131 ile ayni: cumle kelime kelime yanlis degil, ama kullanicinin kurdugu MODEL urunle celisiyor ve celisme bir dokunus sonra ortaya cikiyor. Yeni metin ONCE erisilebilir olani soyluyor. Uc gerekcenin UC FARKLI SINIF oldugunu (modellenmemis · rakip yok · referans yok) tek cumleye YIKMADI: M-F-287'ye gore o siniflar ayri seyler ve duzlestirmek, kullaniciya "hepsi ayni engel" dedirtirdi. Onun yerine kartlara yonlendiriyor. Kapi: promise_language_test, kurs KATMANI.

disciplines.$blurbWhy: J-162: eski metin 'guard, stance, SEQUENCE and balance' diyordu. OLCUM: dizi koclugunu veren iki replik (cue.combo_order · cue.wrong_hand) COMBINATION_END'de degerlendiriliyor ve HICBIR ACIK DERSTE kamera+kombinasyon BIR ARADA YOK — yedi kombinasyonlu ders var, hepsi kamerasiz; tek kamerali ders (jab) tek teknikli. Yani vaat edilen dort seyin BIRI teslim edilemiyordu. Kalan uc: guard (koclanir), stance ve balance (skorlanir, trackedComponents). Silinen sey ICERIK degil VAAT: kombinasyon replikleri duruyor ve $producers'ta 'awaiting-content' diye beyanli.
disciplines.$authoringFocusNote: authoringFocus = YAZARLIK NOTU, ÜRÜN DAVRANIŞI DEĞİL. Bu alanın çalışma anında TÜKETİCİSİ YOKTUR: SessionNarrator ders almaz, koç bu listeyi hiç okumaz ve okuma niyeti de yoktur. Buradaki kodlar dersin hangi hatalara odaklandığını YAZARA hatırlatır — kullanıcının duyduğu koçluk 14 hata kodunun HEPSİ için aynıdır ve bu liste onu DEĞİŞTİRMEZ. Alanın eski adı `errorFocus`tu ve o ad bir urun yetkisi ima ediyordu: bir yazar buraya bakip REAR_HAND_LOW'un en cok gectigini gordu ve stance dersine 'the thing we watch most' yazdi. Iddia YANLISTI (motorda 5 kod esit 'high', ve en cok fazda degerlendirilen rear hand degil) ama yazar YALAN SOYLEMEDI - DOGRU bir yere bakti, o yer urunu YONETMIYORDU. Bu yuzden: BU ALANDAN KULLANICI IDDIASI TURETILEMEZ ve bunu authoring_focus_test.dart kapisi zorluyor.

disciplines.blurb: Kicks are not in the rule set. The engine reads a striking stance and arm angles; a leg travelling at head height is a different measurement we have not built or checked against coaches.

The camera is not the blocker here — slow forms are the easiest thing it reads, with no motion blur at all. What is missing is the reference: nobody has told us what correct looks like for the 24-form, and we do not grade from our own opinion.
Kata is a pattern across the floor over minutes. We track a body, not where that body is in a room over time, so the part that defines the form is the part we cannot see.

Elbows and knees live at a range where the limbs cross in front of the torso. That is the same overlap our confidence gate already refuses to judge in boxing — opening it would mean grading exactly the frames we throw away.

Spinning and jumping kicks leave the ground and turn. The engine reads one orientation per frame and is told to expect an upright body, so a spin is not a case it can read — and we have not built the second pass that would.
This is a mix of three rule sets and we have one. Nothing here is hard in a new way — it is the boxing, kickboxing and Muay Thai work, added up, and none of the other two exist.

Solo forms are a good fit and the reference gap is the only thing between us. The dummy form stays out for a different reason: the dummy is equipment, and we track the body, not the object it is working against.

whyNotIncluded.intro: Some of this a phone camera cannot see. Some of it needs a second person. And some of it nobody could honestly tell you, however much we measured. Rather than ship a version that guesses, we leave them out and say which is which.

items.reason: Grappling is defined by contact and resistance from another person. A solo camera sees neither, so any score would be invented.
Same reason as BJJ: the technique lives in the connection between two bodies. Solo drilling exists, but grading it would mean grading the half you can see.
Throws depend on your partner's balance and reaction. Uchikomi without a partner is a movement rehearsal, not the technique.
The technique is defined by where the weapon is. Pose estimation tracks the body, not the object, so the part that matters most is invisible.
Both need a second person. We support solo drills that prepare you for them, and we say clearly that this is not the same thing.
Force needs a sensor. A camera can estimate timing and tempo — we show those as bands — but we will not print a power number we cannot measure.
We can help you train movement. Nobody can promise how a real situation goes, and an app that implies otherwise is doing you harm.
We can see your head move. We cannot tell you whether it was the right move, because right is defined by a punch that isn't there. Grading a slip with nothing to slip would be grading a guess.

We track your body, not the bag — so the thing a coach actually watches, how the bag moves, is invisible to us. Contact also changes what we do read: a punch that lands stops early and returns differently from one that travels free.
A phone across the room cannot hear you, and chest movement during boxing is mostly the boxing. Telling you to breathe on a schedule we cannot check would be advice dressed as feedback.

We read shape, not tissue. Nothing here can tell a sore shoulder from a tired one, and nothing here is medical advice. If something hurts, that decision belongs to you and a professional, not to a camera.
That call weighs things we never see: how you take a shot, how you behave when tired and hit, who you would be in with. A number from solo practice cannot carry it, so we do not print one.

whyNotIncluded.$introWhy: J-153: CERCEVE, KALEMLERIN 10'UNU YANLIS TARIF EDIYORDU. Eski metin: 'Some things a single phone camera genuinely cannot see. Rather than ship a version that guesses, we leave them out and tell you why.' — tek bir sebep ilan ediyordu ('bir telefon kamerasi goremez'). OLCUM: 12 kalemin sinif dagilimi 5 x ikinci kisi gerek · 2 x KAMERA sinirir · 2 x baska SENSOR gerek · 1 x etik/bilgi siniri (kimse soyleyemez) · 1 x TIBBI sinir · 1 x HUKUM yetkisi. Yani cercevenin iddia ettigi sinifta olan yalnizca 2/12. ⚠️ VE BU DUZ BIR DUZLESTIRME DEGIL: kasitli kararlari TEKNIK KISIT gibi gosteriyordu. 'Kamera senin spar'a hazir olup olmadigini goremiyor' demek, 'daha iyi teknoloji bunu cozer' demektir — oysa MUKEMMEL bir kamerayla da o hukmu VERMEYIZ. Teknik kisit ortuk bir VAAT tasir (J-150 sinifi); kasitli karar tasimaz. Tek tek cumleler bunu DOGRU soyluyordu ('That call weighs things we never see… so we do not print one'); yanlis olan CERCEVEYDI. 🎓 Ders: durustluk denetimi cumle cumle yapilamiyor — CERCEVE DE BIR IDDIA.

$comingSoonWhyWorded: Yedi kapali disiplinin metni 2026-08-07'de YENIDEN YAZILDI. OLCUM: 7'nin YALNIZ 1'i (kickboxing) kapali olma SEBEBINI soyluyordu; kalan 6 ya icerik listeliyordu ('Siu Nim Tao through Biu Jee', 'Taegeuk forms and the kick ladder') ya da kapsam beyani yapiyordu. Kart zaten 'This discipline is not open' diyor — NEDEN'i tasimasi gereken yer bu metindi ve tasimyordu. Bir yol haritasi ile bir durustluk beyani ayni sey degil: birincisi ne GELECEGINI soyler, ikincisi neden BUGUN olmadigini. Yeni metinlerin hepsi kod-gercegine dayali: kural seti yok (boxing@1.0.0 14 kod, hepsi yumruk) · referans take'i toplanmadi (M-C-04 kapisi, footwork_combo'yu da kilitleyen ayni kapi) · PassPlan.uprightOnly + OrientationExpectation.exactly(upright) · guven kapisinin zaten reddettigi ortusme. TAI CHI KASTEN FARKLI YAZILDI: orada engel kamera DEGIL (yavas form, sifir bulanma) — engel REFERANS. Yedisine ayni gerekce yazmak, farkli sebepleri tek sebep gibi gostermek olurdu (M-F-287: siniri genis yazmak dar yazmak kadar pahali). AYRICA bir VAAT SILINDI: taekwondo metni 'Jumping and spinning kicks WILL CARRY a visible accuracy warning' diyordu — var olmayan bir disiplin hakkinda gelecek-zaman iddiasi. Karsilastirma icin: r20 dersinin 'it will tell you if it loses you' cumlesi KALDI, cunku o BUGUNKU davranisi anlatiyor (novVerdict yuvasi calisiyor) — kosacagin turu tarif etmek vaat degil.
$teachWhy: teach alani J-118'de eklendi. TeachMaterialText varyanti J-094'ten beri VARDI ve render ediliyordu — ama hicbir yer ONU URETMIYORDU: 17 canli dersin 17'sinde de ogretme asamasi bostu ve ekran 'yapmadik' diyordu. Beyan durusttu, bosluk gercekti. Metinler KOD-GERCEGINE bagli yazildi (J-112 sinifi): kamera dersi 'isigi olcmuyoruz, siz olcebilirsiniz' diyor cunku motorda isik olcumu YOK (cue.low_light bu yuzden silindi) · durus dersi gard elinin KOCLANDIGINI ama PUANLANMADIGINI soyluyor cunku config'in coachedOnlyJoints kovasi oyle diyor (J-113) · cross dersi 'kuvveti olcmuyoruz' diyor (whyNotIncluded/power_measurement) · 1-2 dersi kombinasyon sirasinin YALNIZ modellenen yumruklar icin izlendigini soyluyor (boxing.intermediate.combinations kilit gerekcesiyle ayni olcum) · ilk tur dersi 'gorunmezse SOYLER' diyor (noVerdict yuvasi). Yani ogretme metni pazarlama degil, urunun kendi olculmus sinirlarinin ogretim dilindeki hali. Alan NULLABLE: materyali olan ders tasir, olmayan tasimaz ve ekranda 'yapmadik' der — bos dizeye varsayilanlamak 'yazilmadi' ile 'bos yazildi'yi ayni degere yikardi.
$orphanKeyWhy: J-129: ders duzeyinde `blurb` (6) + `comingSoonInThisDiscipline` (1) SILINDI. ⚠️ DUZELTME (J-145): `lockedBy` (3) de silinmisti ve BU YANLISTI — okuyani VARMIS: `packages/jablab_engine/test/curriculum_binding_test.dart` onu kilit sinifinin makine-okur adi olarak ZORUNLU tutuyor. J-129'un olcumu 'okuyan'i `Lesson.fromJson` ile SINIRLI tanimladi; ham JSON'u okuyan TESTLERE hic bakmadi. Geri kondu. Onemli olan silinmeleri degil NASIL bulunduklari: Lesson.fromJson bu anahtarlari TANIMIYOR ve JSON tanimadigini sessizce dusuruyor — icerik yazildi, ALANI yoktu. Ikisi canli metnin birebir kopyasiydi, ikisi kapsanmisti, IKISI YANLISTI: hiit "punch quality is not judged at this pace" diyordu (J-119 bunu OLCTU ve curuttu), fatigue "watches whether your error rate climbs" diyordu (oyle bir trend hesabi yok, dersin KENDI ogretme metni aksini soyluyor). Okunmayan anahtar, CURUTULMUS IDDIALARIN HAYATTA KALDIGI YERDIR: bu gecenin butun durustluk turlari YUZEYLERI taradi, burasi hicbir yuzeyde degildi. Silinen blurb'e ATIF YAPAN 3 provenance notu canli ogretme metnine yeniden baglandi — yoksa beyan bayatlardi (J-124 kusuru). Kapi: test/content_orphan_key_test.dart, tanimli anahtarlari PARSER KAYNAGINDAN turetir.
$mechanismLanguageWhy: J-131 OLCUTU — hangi mekanizma adi kullaniciya SOYLENEBILIR? Iki kapili test: ① mekanizma CALISMA ZAMANINDA var ve kullanici onu GOZLEYEBILIYOR mu · ② cumle kullaniciyi bir EYLEME cagiriyor mu ("gececegim", "acacagim")? r10'un "progress gate"i ①'de kaldi ve ②'yi yapiyordu → dustu. KALANLAR olculdu ve BILEREK durdu: muay_thai "confidence gate" (① VAR — kullanici "seni goremiyorum"u gorur), honesty "phase machine" (① gozlenmez ama ② YOK — bu bir KOKEN beyani, eylem cagrisi degil), "engine"/"rule set"/"flag" (mekanizma adi degil, sade Ingilizce). Kelime YASAKLAMAK yanlis arac olurdu: aile 04:50'de ayni tuzagi "will" icin olctu — 17 esleşmenin hepsi "will not/will never" idi, yani hattin EN GUCLU durustluk dili. Blanket yasak, dogru cumleleri de oldururdu.
